verdict.rationale: OpenCode's own docs say you can add external tools through MCP, with both local and remote servers supported, so it can plausibly connect to workflow tools. The evidence never names Jira, Slack, or Google Drive, and relies on third-party MCP servers rather than first-party integrations. Missing for 10: named first-party connectors for Jira/Slack/Google Drive, documentation showing workflow-tool context being pulled in, independent hands-on corroboration of such integrations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context

citations.quote: You can add external tools to OpenCode using the _Model Context Protocol_, or MCP. OpenCode supports both local and remote servers.
